title: Jesus... She Sent My Hoodie Back. No Note. 📦
topic: his ex returned his hoodie by courier with no note, and he still checked the pockets for a message

bible.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... she sent my hoodie back by courier today. No note. I still checked the pockets. 📦

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I told my friends it's just a hoodie. I haven't opened the bag since.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You checked the pockets for proof she still cared.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Was any of it real, or was it just me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What you gave was real. Love given honestly is never wasted.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put the hoodie away. Don't put your heart away.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend still checking the pockets. 💌
